title: Wing form and letter construction
slide_intent: Show the formal connection between mascot and type so a designer can understand where a distinctive contour comes from.
strategic_value: A shared wing shape can make Duolingo’s illustrated and typographic elements feel like parts of one identity.
demonstration: Duo raises a wing at left, a dotted contour isolates the shape in the middle, and a large green lowercase a receives the same contour at right.
practical_value: Compare a source shape with its typographic adaptation before extending a visual motif.

content_islands.name: Source pose
content_islands.spec: Place the raised-wing Duo at left with the wing outlined.

content_islands.name: Shape transfer
content_islands.spec: Use arrows around the isolated dotted contour in the center.

content_islands.name: Letter result
content_islands.spec: Outline the terminal on the large a at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The agency narrative says the redrawn logotype draws inspiration from Duo’s feathery form.
reference_purposes.Expression: The diagram traces a wing-like contour into a letter terminal.

ingredient.name: Feather Bold and the Duolingo wordmark
ingredient.application: Use the depicted wing-to-letter comparison to understand the design relationship.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2019 case-study evidence. These are observed design relationships, not a license to redraw the mark or a complete type-usage specification.
